temporal_lag.basis: decoded replay magenta bounds and the exact persisted context sample bounds are independently reverse-matched to the fixture movement clock
temporal_lag.sign_convention: signed_lag_ms = inferred replay pixel wall time - inferred observed context wall time; negative means replay pixels are older
temporal_lag.ambiguity_policy: static motion, no coordinate match, or multiple equally good time clusters produce no inferred lag

source_latency.basis: encoded frame nominal wall time (timeline origin + encoded PTS) minus the independently reverse-matched replay pixel wall time; context query time and nearest-frame distance are not inputs
